metadata.title: Resolve Quota Verification and Git Data Protection
metadata.verdict_rule_applied: Git data protection is resolved (PASS). Manual quota verification in Google Cloud Console remains outstanding (UNVERIFIED). Per governing rules: 'If manual quota verification remains outstanding, report NOT_READY_BILLING_OR_QUOTA_UNVERIFIED'.

gcp_environment_and_billing.quota_reset_cadence: First day of each calendar month at 00:00:00 UTC
gcp_environment_and_billing.query_eligibility: ELIGIBLE. Public dataset on-demand queries in Sandbox draw from monthly 1 TiB free allowance.
gcp_environment_and_billing.shared_allowance_risk: Any queries run by other tools or IAM identities under project canvas-advice-464215-n1 share this quota.
gcp_environment_and_billing.programmatic_read_limitation: BigQuery Python client and gcloud CLI do not expose an API endpoint for current-month remaining Sandbox free bytes. Client job history (client.list_jobs()) is an incomplete proxy that does not prove global quota state.

checkpoints.name: Required Quota versus Available Quota Math
checkpoints.evidence: Candidate A requires 418,578,205,568 bytes (389.83 GiB). Under the 1,024 GiB Sandbox allowance, prior monthly usage must be <= 634.17 GiB (or <= 595.19 GiB with 10% safety margin). Math reconciled exactly.

checkpoints.evidence: Identified 5 existing tracked sample files in data/raw/ (historical Borg 2011 samples). Git rules preserve them; no history rewrite or untracking performed without authorization.
